title: CURLMNOTIFY_TIMER
body:
Add `CURLMNOTIFY_TIMER` that is, be default, triggered every second when this notification is enabled. The timer interval can be set via`CURLMOPT_NOTIFYTIMER_MS`.

`curl`: use CURLMNOTIFY_TIMER to update progress bar in parallel transfers

based on #19511

TODO: documentation
